;Armed conflict and attacks
*[[2014 pro-Russian conflict in Ukraine]]
**[[Arsen Avakov (politician)|Arsen Avakov]], [[Ministry of Internal Affairs (Ukraine)|Ukraine's Minister of the Interior]], claims that Ukrainian forces have recaptured the port of [[Mariupol]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/06/13/us-ukraine-crisis-flag-idUSKBN0EO0MX20140613 (Reuters)]

;Business and economics
*[[Priceline.com]] agrees to purchase [[OpenTable]] for [[US Dollar|US$]]2.6 billion. [http://dealbook.nytimes.com/2014/06/13/priceline-to-buy-opentable-for-2-6-billion/ (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Amaya Gaming Group]] agrees to purchase [[PokerStars]] for US$4.9 billion. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/nathanvardi/2014/06/12/amaya-gaming-in-deal-to-buy-pokerstars-for-4-9-billion/ (''Forbes Magazine'')]
*[[General Motors]] recalls 511,528 [[Chevrolet Camaro]]s over fears that drivers could bump the key out of the "run" position, turning off the car. [http://read.thestar.com/?origref=http%3A%2F%2Fnews.google.com%2F#!/article/539b2007ec0691a04a000c06-another-gm-recall-511-528-chevy-camaros-have-key-fob-defect (''Toronto Star'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*A high speed ferry in [[Macau]] hits a [[Breakwater (structure)|breakwater]], injuring 58 people. [http://www.foxnews.com/world/2014/06/13/macau-high-speed-ferry-hits-breakwater-injuring-58/ (AP via Fox News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Romania|Romanian]] hacker [[Guccifer]] is indicted [[Trial in absentia|in absentia]] in a federal court in the U.S. state of [[Virginia]] for hacking into the e-mails of American government officials and family members. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/northamerica/usa/10897002/Guccifer-hacker-indicted-after-George-H-W-Bushs-personal-email-targeted.html (''The Telegraph'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Park Geun-hye]], the [[President of South Korea]], reshuffles her cabinet by replacing seven members after a fall in public support following the [[Sinking of the MV Sewol|sinking of the MV ''Sewol'']] in April. [https://web.archive.org/web/20140616174133/http://www.voanews.com/content/south-korea-president-shuffles-cabinet/1936032.html (Voice of America)]
*[[Giorgio Orsoni]], the mayor of [[Venice]], [[Italy]], resigns over corruption allegations related to the [[MOSE Project]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/06/13/us-italy-corruption-venice-idUSKBN0EO14T20140613 (Reuters)]
*The [[Thailand|Thai]] [[National Council for Peace and Order|military junta]] announces that it is lifting the nationwide [[curfew]]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20140614015120/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/thai-junta-interim-government-september-24119589 (AP via ABC)]

;Sports
*The [[2013–14 Los Angeles Kings season|Los Angeles Kings]] defeat the [[2013–14 New York Rangers season|New York Rangers]] in five games to win the [[2014 Stanley Cup Final]].
